knowledgePoints.name: 动词时态
knowledgePoints.subject: english
knowledgePoints.summary: 掌握一般现在时、现在进行时、一般过去时和现在完成时的构成与标志词。

objectives: 掌握四种基本时态的构成和用法。
能根据时间标志词判断句子时态。
会用所给动词的适当形式填空。
lesson.keyIdea: 先找时间标志词，再定时态：every day 用一般现在时，look/now 用现在进行时，yesterday 用一般过去时，since/already 用现在完成时。

concepts.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时
content: 一般现在时表示经常性、习惯性的动作，标志词：every day、often、usually、always。主语三单时动词加 -s/-es。
现在进行时表示此刻正在进行的动作，构成 be + doing，标志词：now、look、listen。
Look! The children are playing football. 中 Look 是进行时的强信号。

concepts.title: 一般过去时与现在完成时
content: 一般过去时表示过去发生的动作，动词用过去式，标志词：yesterday、last week、in 2010、two days ago。
现在完成时表示过去发生、对现在有影响的动作，构成 have/has + done，标志词：already、yet、just、ever、since、for。
since + 时间点，for + 时间段：He has lived here since 2010. / He has lived here for over ten years.

formulas.name: 现在完成时
formulas.expression: have/has + 过去分词 + since + 时间点 / for + 时间段

formulas.name: 三单变化
formulas.expression: 主语三单 + V-s/-es（一般现在时）

workedExamples.title: 标志词定时态
steps: every evening 是一般现在时标志词。
主语 my father 是第三人称单数。
动词用 watches。
workedExamples.takeaway: 标志词 + 主语人称，两步定时态。

workedExamples.title: 完成时填空
steps: since 2010 是现在完成时标志词。
主语 he 用 has。
live 的过去分词是 lived。

pitfalls.mistake: 三单主语忘记给动词加 -s。
pitfalls.correction: 一般现在时中 he/she/it 作主语，动词必须用三单形式。
since 接时间点（since 2010），for 接时间段（for ten years）。

lesson.strategy: 做时态题第一步圈出时间标志词；没有标志词就看上下文动作是否正在进行；填空题注意主语人称和数。

knowledgePoints.name: 被动语态
knowledgePoints.subject: english
knowledgePoints.summary: 掌握一般现在时和一般过去时的被动语态构成与使用场景。

objectives: 掌握被动语态的构成 be + 过去分词。
能判断句子该用主动还是被动。
会用所给动词的适当形式（被动）填空。
lesson.keyIdea: 主语是动作的承受者时用被动语态：be + done。时态体现在 be 上。

concepts.title: 被动语态的构成
content: 一般现在时被动：am/is/are + 过去分词。English is spoken by many people.
一般过去时被动：was/were + 过去分词。The bike was repaired yesterday.
含情态动词的被动：情态动词 + be + 过去分词。Trees should be planted in spring.

concepts.title: 主动与被动的判断
content: 主语是动作执行者用主动，主语是动作承受者用被动。
English is spoken（英语被说）——主语 English 是承受者，用被动。
by + 执行者是被动句的常见标志，但没有 by 不代表不能用被动。

formulas.name: 情态动词被动
formulas.expression: 情态动词 + be + 过去分词

workedExamples.title: 一般现在时被动
steps: 主语 the room 是被清扫的对象，用被动。
every day 表一般现在时。
is cleaned。
workedExamples.takeaway: 先判断主被动，再定时态，最后套 be + done。

workedExamples.title: 情态动词被动
workedExamples.problem: Flowers ___ (water) every day, or they will die.
steps: 花是被浇水的对象，用被动。
must 情态动词 + be + done。
must be watered。

pitfalls.mistake: 被动语态漏掉 be 动词，只写过去分词。
pitfalls.correction: be + done 缺一不可，be 负责体现时态和人称。

pitfalls.mistake: 把不及物动词用于被动。
pitfalls.correction: happen、take place 等不及物动词没有被动语态。

lesson.strategy: 看到主语是物、谓语是及物动词，优先考虑被动；填空题三步走：定主被动 → 定时态 → 检查过去分词拼写。

knowledgePoints.name: 从句基础
knowledgePoints.subject: english
knowledgePoints.summary: 掌握宾语从句的语序、时态和引导词，了解定语从句的关系词。

objectives: 掌握宾语从句用陈述语序的规则。
掌握宾语从句主现从任、主过从过的时态规则。
能根据句意选择宾语从句和定语从句的引导词。
lesson.keyIdea: 宾语从句三要素：引导词、语序（一律陈述语序）、时态（主现从任、主过从过）。

concepts.title: 宾语从句
content: 语序：宾语从句一律用陈述语序。I want to know where he lives.（不说 where does he live）
时态：主句现在时，从句按实际时态；主句过去时，从句用相应过去时态。
引导词：陈述内容用 that；问是否用 if/whether；特殊疑问用疑问词本身。

concepts.title: 定语从句
content: 先行词是人用 who/that，先行词是物用 which/that。
This is the book that I bought yesterday. 先行词是物，作宾语可用 that。
关系词在从句中作主语时不可省略。

formulas.name: 宾语从句语序
formulas.expression: 引导词 + 主语 + 谓语（陈述语序）

workedExamples.title: 宾语从句语序
workedExamples.problem: I want to know ___. A. where does he live B. where he lives
steps: 宾语从句必须用陈述语序。
B 选项是主语 + 谓语的陈述语序。
选 B。
workedExamples.takeaway: 看到疑问词后紧跟助动词（does/do/did），多半是语序错误。

workedExamples.title: 主过从过
workedExamples.problem: He said that he ___ (finish) the work the next day.
steps: 主句 he said 是过去时。
按主过从过，从句用过去将来时 would finish。
也可以理解为过去时态范围内的相应形式。

pitfalls.correction: 无论引导词是什么，从句一律陈述语序。

pitfalls.mistake: 主句过去时从句仍用现在时。
pitfalls.correction: 主过从过；但客观真理除外。

lesson.strategy: 宾语从句题目按“引导词 → 语序 → 时态”三步检查；定语从句先找先行词，人用 who 物用 which。

knowledgePoints.name: 词汇辨析
knowledgePoints.subject: english
knowledgePoints.summary: 掌握常见近义词和词形变化的核心区别。

objectives: 掌握 borrow/lend、spend/cost/pay/take 等常见易混词的区别。
掌握名词、动词、形容词之间的词形变化。
能在语境中选用正确的词形。
lesson.keyIdea: 易混词抓住各自的固定搭配和主语特征；词形转化题先判断句中缺什么成分。

concepts.title: 易混动词
content: borrow（借入）与 lend（借出）：Can you lend me your pen? / I borrowed a book from the library.
spend（人花费，spend...on/doing）、cost（物花费，sth costs sb...）、pay（人付款，pay for）、take（it takes sb... to do）。
reach 及物直接接地点；get to + 地点；arrive in + 大地点 / arrive at + 小地点。

concepts.title: 词形转化
content: 动词变名词：invent → invention；形容词变副词：careful → carefully。
缺主语或宾语用名词形式，缺谓语用动词，修饰动词或形容词用副词。
先分析句子成分，再决定词形。

formulas.name: 花费句型
formulas.expression: sb spends...(on/doing)；sth costs...；sb pays...for；It takes sb...to do

formulas.name: 到达三兄弟
formulas.expression: reach + 地点；get to + 地点；arrive in/at + 地点

workedExamples.title: cost 与 spend
workedExamples.problem: The book ___ me ten yuan. A. spent B. cost C. paid D. took
steps: 主语是 the book（物）。
物作主语用 cost。
选 B。
workedExamples.takeaway: 主语是物用 cost，主语是人用 spend/pay。

workedExamples.title: 词形转化
workedExamples.problem: Tom is a careful boy and he does everything ___. (careful)
steps: 修饰动词 does 需要副词。
careful 的副词是 carefully。
填 carefully。

pitfalls.mistake: borrow 和 lend 方向混淆。
修饰动词时仍用形容词。
pitfalls.correction: 修饰实义动词要用副词形式。

lesson.strategy: 辨析题先看主语（人还是物）和介词搭配；词形转化题先分析句子缺什么成分再填。

knowledgePoints.name: 情景交际
knowledgePoints.subject: english
knowledgePoints.summary: 掌握常见日常交际情景的习惯表达。

objectives: 掌握问候、感谢、道歉、邀请等情景的常用应答。
能根据上下文选择符合英语习惯的表达。
避免中式英语。
lesson.keyIdea: 交际题不看语法对错，看是否符合英语情景习惯；问什么答什么。

concepts.title: 常见情景应答
content: 问候：How are you? → Fine, thank you. And you?
感谢：Thank you (for...). → You're welcome. / Not at all. / It's a pleasure.
道歉：I'm sorry. → It doesn't matter. / Never mind.
邀请：Would you like...? → Yes, I'd love to. / I'd love to, but...

concepts.title: 易错情景
content: 问职业：What do you do? / What does your mother do?（不用 Who is your mother?）
接受帮助说 Yes, please.，拒绝说 No, thanks.（注意 thanks 与 please 的区别）。
对 Would you mind...? 的否定回答用 Of course not. / Not at all. 表示不介意。

formulas.name: 感谢应答
formulas.expression: You're welcome. = Not at all. = My pleasure.

formulas.name: 邀请应答
formulas.expression: 接受：Yes, I'd love to. 拒绝：I'd love to, but...

workedExamples.title: 拒绝邀请
workedExamples.problem: —Would you like some more rice? —___. I'm full. A. Yes, please B. No, thanks
steps: 后面说 I'm full（我饱了）。
表示拒绝用 No, thanks。
选 B。
workedExamples.takeaway: 拒绝提供的东西用 No, thanks；拒绝邀请用 I'd love to, but...

workedExamples.title: 问职业
workedExamples.problem: —___? —She is a nurse. A. Who is the woman B. What does the woman do
steps: 答语回答的是职业。
问职业用 What do/does sb. do?
选 B。

pitfalls.mistake: 回答 Would you like...? 时说 Yes, I would.
pitfalls.correction: 习惯表达是 Yes, please.（接受物品）或 Yes, I'd love to.（接受邀请）。

pitfalls.mistake: 把中文习惯直译成英语。
pitfalls.correction: 交际题以英语习惯为准，逐个情景记忆固定表达。

lesson.strategy: 交际题先看答语反推问句情景；把课本每个单元的 Functional Sentences 整理成情景卡片记忆。

knowledgePoints.name: 比较级与最高级
knowledgePoints.subject: english
knowledgePoints.summary: 掌握形容词、副词比较级和最高级的构成与句型。

objectives: 掌握比较级和最高级的规则变化与不规则变化。
掌握“比较级 + than”和“the + 最高级 + 范围”句型。
能在语境中正确选用原级、比较级或最高级。
lesson.keyIdea: 两者比较用比较级 + than；三者以上比较用 the + 最高级 + in/of 短语；不规则变化单独记忆。

concepts.title: 规则变化
content: 单音节词一般在词尾加 -er / -est：tall → taller → tallest。
以重读闭音节结尾且末尾只有一个辅音字母，双写该字母再加：big → bigger → biggest，hot → hotter → hottest。
以“辅音字母 + y”结尾，变 y 为 i 再加：early → earlier → earliest。
多音节词和部分双音节词在前面加 more / most：interesting → more interesting → most interesting。

concepts.title: 不规则变化与句型
content: good / well → better → best；bad / badly → worse → worst；many / much → more → most；little → less → least；far → farther / further。
两者比较：A + 比较级 + than + B。
三者及以上：A + the + 最高级 + in / of 短语。
同级比较用 as + 原级 + as（否定 not as/so + 原级 + as）。

formulas.name: 比较级句型
formulas.expression: A + V + 比较级 + than + B

formulas.name: 最高级句型
formulas.expression: A + V + the + 最高级 + in/of + 范围

workedExamples.title: 选比较级
steps: 句中有 than，两者比较用比较级。
tall 的比较级是 taller。

workedExamples.title: 选最高级
workedExamples.problem: She is ___ (good) student in our class.
steps: in our class 表示比较范围超过两者。
用最高级：the best。
good 的最高级是 best。

pitfalls.mistake: 比较级与 more 连用：more taller。
pitfalls.correction: 单音节词直接加 -er，不加 more。
形容词最高级前一般要加 the。

lesson.strategy: 解题三步：数比较对象（两个用比较级，三个以上用最高级）→ 判断规则或不规则变化 → 核对句型标志词 than / in / of。

knowledgePoints.name: 情态动词
knowledgePoints.subject: english
knowledgePoints.summary: 掌握 can、must、should 等情态动词的用法。

objectives: 掌握情态动词后接动词原形的规则。
掌握 must、should、can 等词的基本意义。
记住 must 提问的否定回答用 needn't。
lesson.keyIdea: 情态动词无人称和数的变化，后面必须接动词原形；情态动词不能单独作谓语。

concepts.title: 基本特征与常用词
content: 情态动词后接动词原形；没有人称和数的变化；否定式直接在后面加 not。
can 表示能力或许可；must 表示必须（主观义务）；should 表示建议、应该；may 表示许可或可能。
mustn't 表示“禁止”，而 needn't 表示“没有必要”。

concepts.title: must 提问的回答
content: —Must I finish the work today? —Yes, you must. / No, you needn't.（不必）
must 的否定式 mustn't 表示“千万不要”，不是“不必”。
表示“不必”用 needn't 或 don't have to。

formulas.name: 基本结构
formulas.expression: 主语 + 情态动词 + 动词原形

formulas.name: must 提问应答
formulas.expression: Must I...? —Yes, you must. / No, you needn't.

workedExamples.title: 选情态动词
workedExamples.problem: Students ___ keep quiet in the library.
steps: 图书馆保持安静是义务要求。
用 must（必须）。
must 后接动词原形 keep。
workedExamples.takeaway: 表示规则义务用 must / have to。

workedExamples.title: must 提问应答
workedExamples.problem: —Must I hand in my homework now? —No, you ___.
steps: must 提问的否定回答用 needn't。
mustn't 是“禁止”，不符合语境。
填 needn't。

pitfalls.mistake: 情态动词后接 to do 或三单形式。
pitfalls.correction: 情态动词后一律接动词原形。

pitfalls.mistake: 把 mustn't 当作“不必”回答 Must 提问。
pitfalls.correction: mustn't 是“禁止”；“不必”用 needn't。

lesson.strategy: 情态动词题先看语气（能力用 can、义务用 must、建议用 should）；回答 Must 提问锁定 needn't。

knowledgePoints.name: 听力理解
knowledgePoints.subject: english
knowledgePoints.summary: 短对话听力与听句填词：预读题目抓关键词，听转折与最后决定，练数字、时间、地点的速记。

objectives: 掌握听前预读、预测题点的准备方法
学会抓关键词：数字、时间、地点、转折词后的信息
能听懂初中常见话题短对话并正确作答
lesson.keyIdea: 听力不是逐字听懂，而是带着问题去'抓'关键信息：先读题预测，再听重点词，最后跟上'改主意'和'最后决定'。

concepts.title: 听前预读与预测
content: 利用放音前的时间读题干和选项
圈出选项里的差异词（学科、时间、地点）
预测可能出现的词汇家族，如 weather → sunny / rainy / cloudy

concepts.title: 抓关键词与速记
content: 数字与时间：边听边换算（half past nine = 9:30；20% off = 打 8 折）
地点与人物：who / where / what 速记首字母
转折词 but / however 之后往往是真正答案

concepts.title: 同义转换与语气
content: 选项常把听力原文换一种说法：enjoy best = favorite
语调上扬的疑问、迟疑的 well/er 常暗示否定或改主意
最后一句 frequently 是结论句

formulas.name: 听力三步法
formulas.expression: 预读预测 → 抓关键词 → 听最后决定
formulas.note: 拿到题先看选项差异，听时盯关键词，答案常在转折和结尾处。

formulas.name: 速记符号
formulas.expression: 数字记阿拉伯数字，↑=increase，↓=decrease，?=疑问

workedExamples.title: 例题：改主意型对话
workedExamples.problem: W: Would you like coffee or tea? M: Coffee, please. Oh, wait — I'd better not drink coffee at night. Just water, thanks. 男士最后喝什么？
steps: 预读选项：coffee / tea / water / milk
听到 Coffee, please 时先标记 A
听到 Oh, wait — Just water 时改成 C
结论：改主意题跟到最后一刻
workedExamples.takeaway: Oh wait / but / well 出现时，前面的话要重新审视。

pitfalls.mistake: 听到什么选什么，被先出现的干扰项带跑
pitfalls.correction: 先出现的名词常是铺垫，but / wait / however 后才是定论。

pitfalls.mistake: 数字题听完就算完，不做换算
pitfalls.correction: 价格打折、时间提前都要当场算完再选。

lesson.strategy: 每段对话只读两遍：第一遍抓大意和关键词，第二遍核对细节。听完立刻作答，不要留到下一题还在回想上一题。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Look! The children ___ football on the playground.
questions.explanation: Look! 提示动作正在发生，用现在进行时 are playing。
questions.optimalSolution: Look! / Listen! / now 是现在进行时的强标志。
questions.commonMistake: 忽略 Look! 选成一般现在时。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My father ___ to Beijing on business last week.
questions.explanation: last week 是一般过去时标志词，动词用过去式 went。
questions.optimalSolution: last week / yesterday / in 2010 都是一般过去时标志词。
questions.commonMistake: 受汉语影响误选 has gone。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 用所给词的适当形式填空：He ___ (live) here since 2010.
questions.explanation: since 2010 是现在完成时标志词，主语 he 用 has + 过去分词，即 has lived。
questions.optimalSolution: since + 时间点 → 现在完成时 have/has + done。
questions.commonMistake: 只写 lived，忽略 since 引出的完成时。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: English ___ by many people around the world.
questions.explanation: English 是被说的对象，用一般现在时被动语态 is spoken。
questions.optimalSolution: 主语是物且是动作承受者 → be + done。
questions.commonMistake: 选 speaks，忽略主语是承受者。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The classroom ___ yesterday, so it is clean now.
questions.explanation: 教室是被打扫的对象，yesterday 表过去，用 was cleaned。
questions.optimalSolution: 先定被动，再由 yesterday 定一般过去时。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 用所给词的适当形式填空：Trees ___ (plant) in spring every year.
questions.explanation: 树是被种的对象，every year 表一般现在时，主语 trees 复数，用 are planted。
questions.optimalSolution: 被动 + 一般现在时 + 复数主语 → are done。
questions.commonMistake: 漏掉 are 或把 planted 写成 planting。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I want to know ___.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序，主语 he 是三单，谓语用 lives，故选 B。
questions.optimalSolution: 疑问词后出现助动词就是语序错误。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: This is the book ___ I bought yesterday.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the book 是物，关系词在从句中作宾语，用 which 或 that。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 填入合适的引导词：—Do you know ___ the meeting will begin? —At nine o'clock.
questions.explanation: 答语 At nine o'clock 表示时间，引导词用 when。
questions.optimalSolution: 从答语反推引导词：答时间用 when，答地点用 where。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Can you ___ me your dictionary? I left mine at home.
questions.explanation: lend 表示“借出”，lend sb. sth. 是固定搭配；borrow 表示“借入”。
questions.optimalSolution: 借出用 lend，借入用 borrow。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The dictionary ___ me fifty yuan.
questions.explanation: 主语是物（the dictionary），表示“花费”用 cost。
questions.optimalSolution: 物作主语用 cost，人作主语用 spend/pay。
questions.commonMistake: 主语是人还是物没看清。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 用所给词的适当形式填空：Tom did his homework very ___ (careful).
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 did 要用副词，careful 的副词是 carefully。
questions.optimalSolution: 修饰实义动词用副词形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: —Thank you for helping me with my English. —___
questions.explanation: 对感谢的应答用 You're welcome.（不客气）。
questions.optimalSolution: 感谢 → You're welcome. / Not at all.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: —Would you like some more rice? —___. I'm full.
questions.explanation: 后面说 I'm full（饱了），表示委婉拒绝用 No, thanks.
questions.optimalSolution: 拒绝提供的食物用 No, thanks.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: —___? —She is a nurse in a hospital.
questions.explanation: 答语回答职业，问职业用 What do/does sb. do?
questions.optimalSolution: 从答语反推问句：答职业 → 问职业。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 补全对话：—Thank you for your help. —You're w_______. （填出应答单词）
questions.explanation: 对感谢的应答是 You're welcome.（不客气）。
questions.optimalSolution: 感谢 → You're welcome. / Not at all.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Tom is ___ than his brother.
questions.explanation: 句中有 than，两者比较用比较级 taller。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 关于比较级和最高级，下列说法正确的有（　）

options.label: interesting 的最高级是 most interesting

questions.explanation: good 是不规则变化：better → best，D 错；A、B、C 的变化规则均正确。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She is ___ (good) student in our class.
questions.explanation: in our class 表示比较范围超过两者，用最高级 the best。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Students ___ keep quiet in the library.
questions.explanation: 图书馆保持安静是规则义务，用 must 表示“必须”。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 关于情态动词，下列说法正确的有（　）

options.label: 情态动词后接动词原形
情态动词没有人称和数的变化
情态动词的否定式直接在其后加 not
情态动词可以单独作谓语

questions.explanation: 情态动词不能单独作谓语，必须与动词原形连用，D 错；A、B、C 正确。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: —Must I finish the work today? —No, you ___.
questions.explanation: must 提问的否定回答用 needn't（不必）；mustn't 表示“禁止”。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下列时态与其标志词对应正确的有（　）
questions.explanation: since 2010 是现在完成时标志词，D 错；A、B、C 对应正确。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What will the weather be like this afternoon?
questions.listeningScript: M: What's the weather like today? W: It's sunny now, but the radio says it will rain this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 女士说 the radio says it will rain this afternoon，所以下午有雨。听力要点：转折词 but 后是重点。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Where is the city library?
questions.listeningScript: W: Excuse me, how can I get to the city library? M: Go straight and turn left at the second crossing. It's next to the post office.
questions.explanation: 男士说 It's next to the post office。听方位词时最好在心里画一张简易地图。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Why is Lucy happy?
questions.listeningScript: M: Hi, Lucy. You look happy today. W: Yes, I got an A in my English exam. M: Congratulations!

options.label: She got an A in English.

questions.explanation: Lucy 说 I got an A in my English exam。注意区分学科的干扰信息。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: When does the train leave?
questions.listeningScript: W: What time does the train leave? M: At half past nine. And we should arrive at the station twenty minutes earlier.
questions.explanation: half past nine = 9:30；提前 20 分钟是到达时间（9:10），是干扰项。数字题要做简单换算。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What will the woman drink at last?
questions.listeningScript: M: Would you like some coffee or tea? W: Coffee, please. Oh, wait — the doctor says I'd better not drink coffee at night. Just a glass of water, thanks.
questions.explanation: 女士先要咖啡又改主意：Just a glass of water。听力要跟到最后一刻，改主意的题非常常见。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What is Tom doing?
questions.listeningScript: W: Tom, it's time for dinner! M: Coming, Mom. Let me save my game first.
questions.explanation: Tom 说 Let me save my game first，说明他正在打游戏。推断题要抓动作细节。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: How much will the man pay for two T-shirts?
questions.listeningScript: M: How much is this T-shirt? W: It's 50 yuan, but there's a sale today — 20% off. M: Great, I'll take two.
questions.explanation: 50 元打 8 折 = 40 元/件，两件 = 80 元。价格题要边听边算。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What did the man do last night?
questions.listeningScript: W: Did you watch the basketball match last night? M: No, I was busy preparing my speech. How was it? W: Amazing! Our team won by two points.
questions.explanation: 男士说 I was busy preparing my speech。问'男的做了什么'时要盯紧男声内容。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What's the matter with the man?
questions.listeningScript: M: I'm not feeling well. I have a headache and a sore throat. W: You'd better see a doctor and drink more water. Don't worry — it's not serious.

options.label: He has a headache and a sore throat.

questions.explanation: a headache and a sore throat 是关键词。身体不适类对话要记准部位。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: How will they go to the museum?
questions.listeningScript: W: Shall we go to the museum by bus or by bike? M: The museum is not far. Let's ride bikes — it's good for the environment.
questions.explanation: Let's ride bikes 直接给出答案。出行方式题注意 but/let's 后的最终决定。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What must the boy do before the party?
questions.listeningScript: M: Mom, can I go to Jim's birthday party this Saturday? W: Sure, but you must finish your homework first. And remember to come back before 9 p.m.
questions.explanation: you must finish your homework first。条件句里 first 前的内容常是考点。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What will John do after he returns?
questions.listeningScript: W: Hello, this is Mary speaking. May I speak to John? M: Sorry, he's out playing football. Can I take a message? W: Yes, please tell him to call me back when he returns.
questions.explanation: tell him to call me back。电话场景记两件事：留言内容 + 回复动作。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What's Kate's favorite subject now?
questions.listeningScript: M: What's your favorite subject, Kate? W: I used to like art, but now I enjoy science best because it's full of fun experiments.
questions.explanation: used to like art 是过去，now I enjoy science best 是现在。时间对比题以'现在'为答案。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What will the man do in the sports meeting?
questions.listeningScript: W: The school sports meeting is coming. Will you take part in the long jump? M: No, I'll run the 800-meter race. What about you? W: I'll cheer for you!
questions.explanation: 男士明确说 I'll run the 800-meter race。跳远是他不做的事，属干扰项。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What is the woman going to do during the vacation?
questions.listeningScript: M: Winter vacation is coming. Any plans? W: I'm going to visit my grandparents in the countryside and help on the farm. M: Sounds interesting! I'll just stay at home and read.
questions.explanation: 女士说 visit my grandparents in the countryside。计划类对话注意 be going to / will 后的动作。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 听句子，写出句中你听到的动词短语（两个词）。
questions.listeningScript: Please turn off the lights when you leave the classroom.
questions.explanation: turn off 关闭（灯/电器）。turn on 是打开，注意区分 on 和 off。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 听句子，写出句中你听到的动词短语（be 动词 + 介词）。
questions.listeningScript: My father is good at cooking, and he often makes delicious noodles for us.
questions.explanation: be good at = 擅长。注意 at 不要漏写。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 听句子，写出句中你听到的时间短语（三个词）。
questions.listeningScript: It took me half an hour to walk to school because the bus was late.
questions.explanation: half an hour 半小时。注意 an 不要写成 a。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 听句子，写出句中你听到的动词短语（两个词）。
questions.listeningScript: Remember to put on your coat, it's getting colder and colder outside.
questions.explanation: put on 穿上。wear 是状态，put on 是动作。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 听句子，写出句中你听到的动词短语（两个词，'照顾'）。
questions.listeningScript: We should look after the old and help each other in our daily life.
questions.explanation: look after = take care of 照顾。each other 互相。
